name: Soap Bubble Nebula - Entrance
description: You're floating on an impossibly large soap bubble in a nebula of prismatic wonder
long_description: The moment you step through the portal, gravity becomes a suggestion rather than a rule. You're standing - or floating, it's ambiguous - on the surface of a soap bubble the size of a small planet. The bubble's surface ripples gently beneath your feet, creating mesmerizing interference patterns that shift through every color imaginable and a few that definitely aren't. Around you, millions of other bubbles float through space, each one reflecting and refracting the light of distant stars. Some bubbles are tiny, no bigger than a marble, while others dwarf entire asteroids. The air (if it is air) smells like a mixture of lavender soap, ozone, and possibility. To the north, you can see a larger bubble that appears to serve as some kind of central plaza. South leads back to the airlock. You can hear faint, melodious humming - either from the bubbles themselves or from whatever lives here. It's beautiful, surreal, and makes you question whether your morning coffee was actually coffee.
